page.overview:
What is Shueisha?

The company was founded in 1925 as the entertainment-related publishing division of Japanese publisher Shogakukan. The following year, Shueisha became a separate, independent company.

Magazines published by Shueisha include Weekly Shōnen Jump, Weekly Young Jump, Non-no, and Ultra Jump, two of which publish JoJo's Bizarre Adventure.

Shueisha, along with Shogakukan and Hakusensha, owns VIZ Media, which publishes manga from all three companies in North America.

Also known as: 集英社, Jump Comics.
